subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 08, 2026
body:
Recent improvements to our continuous integration pipeline have significantly reduced the likelihood of publish races between concurrent builds, ensuring that our users receive the latest ISO images in a timely and reliable manner. This change, which utilizes per-pipeline staging directories, is a key step forward in maintaining the stability and integrity of our release process.

Development 
The development team has been actively reviewing recent upstream activity around Arch Linux and related tooling to ensure that AcreetionOS remains aligned with the latest developments in the Linux desktop ecosystem. By staying up-to-date with the latest changes, we can provide our users with a seamless and polished desktop experience. For more information on our development process, please visit https://acreetionos.org/docs.html.

Community 
The AcreetionOS community has been actively engaged in discussions around system sovereignty and privacy, with many users appreciating the emphasis we place on these core principles. Our wiki, located at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html, contains a wealth of information on how to get the most out of your AcreetionOS system, including tips on maintaining your system's security and integrity. To stay informed about the latest developments and security updates, be sure to check out our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.
